query: update cards set template = $3, settings = $4, theme = $5, first_name = $6, last_name = $7, job_title = $8, company = $9, description = $10, email = $11, phone = $12, links = $13, header_media_id = $14, avatar_media_id = $15, updated_at = now() where id = $1 and owner_id = $2 and ($14::uuid is null or exists ( select 1 from media where id = $14 and card_id = $1 and slot = 'header')) and ($15::uuid is null or exists ( select 1 from media where id = $15 and card_id = $1 and slot = 'avatar'))
